title: Solve inequalities
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the inequality (with x), used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Solve. Write your answer as x and a sign and a number (like x > 4). Show your work.

items.prompt: A taxi charges $3 plus $2 for each mile. Lena has at most $15. Write and solve an inequality for how many miles she can ride.
Sam solved −4x > 8 and got x > −2. Is he right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: x < -2 (No: dividing by −4 flips the sign)

items.prompt: A phone has 80% battery and loses 5% each hour. Write and solve an inequality for how many hours until it has 20% or less.
Ava solved 2x − 3 > −11 and got x < −4, because the answer was negative. Is she right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: x > -4 (No: only dividing by a negative flips the sign)
